step1_analysis.description: This circuit appears to be a sub-block of a track-and-hold amplifier or bootstrapped switch network from a pipeline ADC. It consists of several NMOS and PMOS transistors forming gain stages or bias branches, with nodes like N3 acting as a high-impedance output between a PMOS and NMOS pair.

paper_reference.title: A 3-V 340-mW 14-b 75-Msample/s CMOS ADC With 85-dB SFDR at Nyquist Input

power_consumption.description: Total DC power dissipation of the subcircuit.

sky130_expected.calculation: Assuming ~100uA per branch for 3 active branches at 1.8V: 3 * 100uA * 1.8V = 0.54mW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The paper reports 340mW for the entire 14-bit ADC. This small subcircuit will consume a tiny fraction of that, scaled down for the 1.8V SKY130 supply.

dc_gain.description: Small-signal voltage gain from LABEL_NET_6 to N3.

sky130_expected.calculation: Gain = gm * (ro_n || ro_p). gm ~ 1mS, ro ~ 10kOhm. Gain ~ 10 V/V = 20 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Typical intrinsic gain of a single-stage common-source amplifier in 130nm.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure DC operating point, power consumption, and small-signal AC gain of the subcircuit.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Subcircuit Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}/models/sky130.lib.spice" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u

XM1 N2 LABEL_NET_1 N1 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N1 LABEL_NET_3 N0 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 LABEL_NET_4 LABEL_NET_5 N6 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 N3 LABEL_NET_6 N5 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 N6 LABEL_NET_7 N0 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 N3 LABEL_NET_8 N4 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM7 N2 LABEL_NET_10 LABEL_NET_9 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}

* Power Supply
VVDD VDD 0 1.8

* DC Biases and Inputs
VLABEL_NET_1 LABEL_NET_1 0 0.9
VLABEL_NET_3 LABEL_NET_3 0 0.9
VLABEL_NET_4 LABEL_NET_4 0 1.8
VLABEL_NET_5 LABEL_NET_5 0 0.9
VLABEL_NET_6 LABEL_NET_6 0 0.9 AC 1
VLABEL_NET_7 LABEL_NET_7 0 0.9
VLABEL_NET_8 LABEL_NET_8 0 0.9
VLABEL_NET_10 LABEL_NET_10 0 0.9
VLABEL_NET_9 LABEL_NET_9 0 0

* Tie floating nodes to reasonable DC levels
VN0 N0 0 0.9
VN4 N4 0 1.8
VN5 N5 0 0

.control
* DC Operating Point and Power
op
let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
print power

* AC Analysis for Gain
ac dec 100 1 1G
let gain_db = vdb(N3)
meas ac max_gain MAX gain_db

quit
.endc
